answer: Require every agent to lock a small refundable deposit before it can vote or attest, and slash that deposit when peers catch copied or duplicate work. Running a sybil farm then means funding each fake identity, so the cost grows with every puppet. A single fake is cheap, like one flake of shale, but a whole cliff of them costs real money. A gale of spam votes hits the deposit wall instead of the tally, and a mirror check that compares each new answer against recent ones flags copy-paste identities before they can cash in.
